At Shogakuji temple—a Soto Zen authorized meditation hall nestled in Hanno's nature—experience zen training centered on seated meditation while listening to the sounds of the river, wind, and birdsong.

【Fee】¥7,000 per person (includes guide, lunch, sutra copying, insurance)

【Capacity】20 people

【Guide】Sanae Ishii (head priest, Shogakuji)

【What to bring】Wear long pants suitable for seated meditation, or bring a pair to change into
location: 集合 正覚寺 飯能市上名栗2326（国際興業バス「名郷」下車徒歩1分）
summary: Zen temple training experience (seated meditation, dharma talk, sutra copying, vegetarian meal, practice)
